summary: Backend testing of the new period-based overtime endpoints (people-ops). All 20 pytest cases pass including period-config CRUD, employee-level override set/remove, period bounds computation (weekly Mon-Sun, biweekly 1-15/16-EOM, monthly 1-EOM), daily entry validation, list/detail, update+re-compute, approve/reject/delete lifecycle, and legacy regression.
critical_code_review_comments: delete endpoint blocks 'paid' but the review request also asked for 'approved' to be blockable via delete (spec only said blocked-for-paid, which matches implementation) — OK.
employee override endpoint returns 200 with unset even when employee_id doesn't exist (matched_count=0 path not raising 404); consider raising 404 for consistency with set path.
No pagination for GET /overtime/periods (limit=100 default). Consider skip/limit for large orgs.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 overtime_period_requests during test; test suite cleans up pending ones, but approved+rejected remain in DB (expected — approved/paid cannot be deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new period-based overtime endpoints (GET/PUT period-config, PUT employee-period, POST/GET/PUT/DELETE periods, POST approve/reject) verified working. Legacy /overtime/requests untouched. Rates_at_creation snapshot stored. Approve/reject 2nd call returns 404 as designed.
